originalTitle: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
title: Hooray! Africa Looks BIGGER and TRUER on New Maps!
content:
Welcome, Super Kids!

Hello, hello, my amazing friends! It's your favorite kid-friendly news reporter here, bringing you super exciting news from our wonderful continent, Africa! Are you ready for a big story? It's about maps, and it's about how BIG Africa truly is! Get ready to cheer!

Our Maps Are Changing! Guess Why?

For a very long time, many maps in the world showed Africa looking smaller than it really is. Can you believe it? It was like someone drew a picture of your favorite fruit, but made it look tiny when it's actually big and juicy! Well, guess what? The grown-ups at a place called the United Nations, which is like a super big club for all countries, have voted! They voted to make new maps that show Africa's true, giant size! This is such wonderful news for all of us!

What is a Map, Anyway?

Before we jump into the super exciting news, let's remember what a map is. A map is like a special drawing or picture of our Earth, or a part of it. It helps us see where countries, cities, and oceans are. It's like a treasure map, but for the whole world! Our Earth is shaped like a ball, right? (It's called a sphere!) But when we try to draw it on a flat piece of paper, things can get a bit tricky. Imagine trying to flatten a bouncy ball! It's hard to make it perfectly flat without stretching or squishing some parts.

The Old Maps Were a Little Tricky

Many of the old maps we used in schools and saw in books were made a very, very long time ago. They were trying their best to show our round Earth on flat paper. But because of this, some parts of the world looked bigger than they really were, and other parts looked smaller. Guess which continent often looked smaller? Yes, our beautiful Africa! This map type is called the "Mercator projection." Don't worry about the big name! Just know it made some places look super big, especially places far from the middle of the Earth. **Did you know?** The Mercator map was made over 400 years ago! It was very helpful for sailors sailing ships, but not so good for showing the true size of countries!

Africa is SUPER HUGE!

This is the most exciting part! Africa is not just big; it's SUPER DUPER HUGE! It's the second-largest continent in the whole wide world. When you look at the old maps, Greenland (a big island near the North Pole) often looked bigger than Africa. But guess what? Africa is actually fourteen times bigger than Greenland! Yes, 14 times! That's like having 14 Greenlands inside Africa! Imagine taking the United States of America, that's a very big country, and placing it inside Africa. It would fit! Now, imagine taking China, another huge country, and placing it inside Africa too! It would fit! What about India, another very big country? Yep, it fits inside Africa! You can even add many countries from Europe – like France, Spain, Germany, Italy, and more – and they would *all* fit inside Africa with lots of space left! Isn't that amazing? Africa is truly a giant!

How Did This Change Happen?

So, who helped make this big change happen? It was our very own African country, Togo! Togo is a lovely country in West Africa. Its leaders and many other people from Togo wanted the world to see Africa for its true, magnificent size. They said, "Hey world! Africa is bigger than you think, and our maps should show that!" They talked to all the other countries at the United Nations. They made a special idea, like a big suggestion, called a "resolution." This resolution asked everyone to agree that new maps should show Africa in its correct, big size. **Did you know?** Togo's official language is French, but many different languages are spoken there too!

A Big Vote at the United Nations

When Togo shared its idea, almost all the countries in the world thought it was a super good idea! Imagine being in a big classroom, and the teacher asks, "Who thinks we should have more playtime?" and almost everyone raises their hand! That's kind of what happened. A total of 164 countries voted "Yes!" They agreed that new maps should show Africa as big as it really is. That's so many countries! It means most of the world wants to celebrate Africa's true size with us. There was only one country that voted "No." That was the United States of America. But don't worry, even with one "No," the idea still won by a very, very big landslide! Almost everyone said "Yes!"

Why Does This Matter So Much?

You might be thinking, "Why is this a big deal, reporter friend?" Well, it matters a lot! 1. **It's about being Fair:** Africa is a huge continent with many amazing people, animals, and beautiful places. It's only fair that maps show its true size. It helps us feel proud of our continent! 2. **Learning the Truth:** When children like you look at maps, we want you to see the real world. Knowing Africa is so big helps you understand how important it is on our planet. It helps you see Africa as powerful and strong, just like it is! 3. **Changing Old Ideas:** For a long time, some people had wrong ideas about Africa because of those old maps. Now, with new maps, we can all learn the truth and appreciate Africa even more. It helps us see Africa as a major player in the world, which it absolutely is! **Did you know?** Africa has more countries than any other continent – 54 amazing countries!

What Happens Next?

Now that the United Nations has voted, mapmakers all over the world will start making new maps. When you go to school next time, or look at an atlas (that's a book full of maps!), you might start seeing these new, improved maps. Africa will look bigger and prouder, just like it should! This means more accurate globes, more accurate maps in your classrooms, and a truer picture of our world for everyone.

Let's Be Proud of Our Giant Africa!

This is such wonderful news for every child in Africa, and for everyone who loves our continent! We can all be very proud that our maps will now show the world how truly vast and incredible Africa is. From the sunny beaches to the mighty mountains, from the bustling cities to the quiet villages, Africa is a continent of wonders, and now its maps will show just how grand it is. So next time you see a map, give a little cheer for our big, beautiful Africa! Hooray for Africa!
summary: The United Nations has voted to use new maps that show Africa's real, giant size, which is much bigger than old maps used to show.
whyMatters: This is important because it helps everyone see Africa's true power and size, makes us proud, and teaches the right information about our amazing continent.

originalTitle: Body of world's youngest traditional king returns home to Uganda amid succession row
title: Our Young King Comes Home to Uganda
content:
Hello, my little friends from all over Africa! I'm your friendly news reporter, here to tell you a story. It's a bit of a sad story today, but it's important. We have some news from a beautiful country called Uganda. This news is about a very special king named King Oyo. King Oyo was a much-loved leader. He has gone to rest after being very sick. Now, his body is coming home to his people in Uganda. Let's talk about this kind king and what it means for his home.

A King from Far Away

King Oyo was a very important person in Uganda. Uganda is a lovely country right here in Africa! He was a traditional king. This means he was a leader in a way that people have chosen for a very, very long time. It's like a special family takes care of the people. King Oyo was part of this special family. Do you know a super amazing secret about King Oyo? He became king when he was just a tiny baby! Can you imagine? A baby king! This made him the youngest king in the whole wide world! He was only three years old when he put on his crown. Wow! That is very, very young. He grew up helping his people. He listened to them and tried to make their lives better. He was a kind and gentle leader for many years.

A Sad Journey

King Oyo was not feeling well. He became very, very sick. It was a very serious sickness, a strong one called cancer. When someone has cancer, doctors try very hard to make them better. So, King Oyo went to a far-away country to get special help. This country is called America. It is very, very far from Uganda. He stayed in America for a while, getting treatment. He was very brave. The doctors and nurses did their best to help him feel stronger. But sometimes, even with all the help, a sickness can be too strong. Last week, King Oyo went to sleep forever in America. This means he passed away. His family and all the people in Uganda are very, very sad. Now, King Oyo's body is coming back home. This is important for his family and his people. They want to bring him back to Uganda. They want to say goodbye in their home country. It is a long journey for him to come home. People in Uganda are waiting for him. They will be there to welcome him one last time. It is a way to show love and respect for their king.

What Happens Next?

When a very important leader like a king goes to rest, many things happen. First, everyone is very sad. They cry, and they remember all the good things the king did. People will talk about King Oyo's kind heart and how he cared for his country. They will share stories about him. Now, a very important question is being asked. Who will be the next king? In a kingdom, when one king leaves us, another king needs to come forward. This is called 'succession.' It means finding the next person in line from the special royal family. It is a big decision. The family of King Oyo and other wise leaders are talking about this. They want to choose the right person to lead the people of Uganda. Did you know? Choosing a new king is a very old tradition. It helps keep the kingdom strong and happy. Everyone hopes for a new leader who will be just as kind and good as King Oyo. They want someone who will care for their land and their people.

Why Kings Are Special

Kings like King Oyo are very special. They are not like presidents that people vote for every few years. Traditional kings follow old customs and ways of doing things. They help keep the history of their people alive. They help people remember where they come from. Uganda is a country that has many different kingdoms. These kingdoms are part of what makes Uganda so rich and wonderful. Each king helps his people live together and celebrates their unique culture. King Oyo was a bright light for his kingdom. He showed everyone how important it is to be kind and strong.

Remembering King Oyo

We will all remember King Oyo. He was a young man, only 34 years old, when he went to rest. That is not very old at all. But in his time as king, he did many good things. He showed courage, even when he was sick. He showed love for his people. His story will be told to children for many, many years to come. Even though we are sad, we can also remember the joy he brought. We can remember his strength. We send our love to the people of Uganda during this sad time. May King Oyo rest in peace, and may his people find comfort and a good new leader very soon. Goodbye for now, my friends.
summary: King Oyo, who was once the world's youngest king, has sadly passed away at age 34 after being very sick, and his body is now returning to his home in Uganda as his people think about who will lead them next.
whyMatters: This is important because King Oyo was a special leader for his people in Uganda. His passing makes everyone sad, and now his family and community must decide who will be the next person to lead their kingdom, which is a big tradition.

originalTitle: ‘Small potatoes’: US President Trump downplays war on Iran
title: Big Leaders Say: No Big Fights Right Now!
content:
Hello, Little Explorers!

Hello, hello, my wonderful friends! It's your friendly African news reporter here, ready to share some interesting news with you. I hope you're all having a super day! Today, we're going to talk about something important, but don't worry, we'll make it easy to understand. It's about countries and peace!

Meeting President Trump

Have you ever heard of a big country called America? It's also called the United States. Well, America has a very important leader. His name is President Trump. A President is like the head of a very big family, but this family is a whole country! He helps make big decisions for everyone in America. He talks to other leaders from all over the world.

A Little Bit of Trouble

Sometimes, countries can have disagreements, just like you might disagree with your friend about which game to play. Recently, there was a little bit of trouble between America and another country called Iran. Iran is also a big country, far away from America. They had what we call an 'exchange of fire'. This means some big machines shot things, not directly at people, but it made loud noises and made many grown-ups worried. It's like when you and your friend have a really big shouting match. It's not fun, and it can be a bit scary. Everyone hopes that things can become calm again very quickly. **Did you know?** Africa has many, many countries, all with their own special leaders! We all try to live in peace and help each other like good neighbors.

President Trump Says "Not Fighting!"

After this little bit of trouble, many grown-ups and news reporters were talking and worrying a lot. They wondered if the trouble would get even bigger. But then, President Trump said something very important. He told the news reporters, "We are not fighting right now." He used a funny phrase, he said it was "small potatoes." What does "small potatoes" mean? It means he thinks it's not a very big problem, like how a tiny potato isn't a whole meal! He was saying, "Don't worry too much, this is not a big, big fight." This means that the leaders are trying to make sure the little trouble does not grow into a huge problem. They want to keep things calm and safe.

Why is "Not Fighting" Good?

Imagine if you and your friends kept fighting every day. Would that be fun? No! Fighting makes everyone sad. Things get broken, and people get hurt. A "war" is when countries fight for a long, long time, and it makes many, many people sad and scared. So, when President Trump says "not fighting right now," it means he wants things to be peaceful. He wants to stop the trouble from getting worse. And peace is always, always better for everyone! When countries are peaceful, they can help each other. They can trade things, share ideas, and visit each other. It's much better than fighting. **Did you know?** The United Nations is like a super big club for almost all the countries in the world! They work hard to help countries be friends and stop fighting.

Working Towards Peace

It's like when you have a small disagreement with your brother or sister. Maybe you argue over a toy. But then, after a little while, you stop arguing and play nicely again. That's what grown-up leaders try to do too. Even after a bit of trouble, they try to find ways to talk and be calm. They want to make sure everyone can live happily and safely in their homes. Leaders from different countries often talk on the phone or meet to sort out their problems. They try to find solutions that make everyone happy and keep the peace.

What We Learn From This

So, what does this news mean for us? It means that even when big countries have problems, their leaders try very hard to stop fighting. President Trump wants to make sure that the big trouble doesn't turn into a bigger, sadder fight. And that's a good thing for everyone in the world, including you and me! It means that people are working to keep our world safe and happy. It shows that even after some trouble, peace is still what everyone wants. **Did you know?** Many wise people from Africa have taught the world about peace and how important it is for all of us to live together as one big family. They teach us to share and be kind.

Let's Choose Peace!

Remember, friends, peace is like sunshine! It makes everyone happy and helps good things grow. When we have peace, we can play, learn, and grow without being scared. Let's always try to choose peace in our own lives, with our friends and family. Because when we choose peace, the whole world becomes a brighter place! Keep smiling, keep learning, and keep spreading kindness! Bye for now!
summary: A big leader named President Trump says his country and another country called Iran are not fighting right now, even though there was a little bit of trouble.
whyMatters: It's important because fighting makes people sad and hurts things, so when leaders try to stop big fights, it helps everyone stay safe and happy in the world.
